name: council
description: Run Codex council reviews with native reviewer agents, bounded orchestration, broad-run approval gates, and supervised synthesis.

interface.longDescription: Council from the SAI Codex collection. Runs focused or broad reviews through native reviewer agents with sourced engineering, UX, reliability, performance, and strategy lenses, supervises reviewer progress, blocks unapproved broad runs, then synthesizes convergence, disagreement, and concrete next moves without leaking raw reviewer payloads.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to review this code or plan with best-fit reviewers.
Use $council all for a broad engineering and UX review after explicit approval.
Use $council debate to compare hard tradeoffs.
